newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi riyal interbank rates rise in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Saudi riyal interbank rates rise in tight market.

text.p: In a tight market, Saudi riyal interbank deposit rates climbed by between 1/16 and 1/8 in the week to Thursday, dealers said.
"There is not much liquidity in the Saudi riyal market, which is causing pressure on rates and also pushing swaps higher," a trader in the kingdom said.
One- and three-month deposits were 1/16 higher in the week at six, 5-15/16 and 6-1/16, 5-15/16 respectively, while six- and 12-month fund rates were up 1/8 at 6-3/16, 1/16 and 6-3/8, 1/4.
The spot riyal was little changed in the week at 3.7506/08 on the dollar.
